title: The Leeward Provision
author: Jude Thackeray
blurb: Edmund Yarrow, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
